description: This file contains implementation of process management and error pipe handling for a server, including functions for creating, freeing, and managing pipes, as well as spawning new processes with specific user and resource limits.

classes.name: liErrorPipe
classes.description: Structure representing an error communication pipe with associated server, callback, and event watchers.

classes.name: liProc
classes.description: Structure representing a server process, its process ID, associated error pipe, application name, and setup callback.

methods.name: void read_pipe(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,gboolean flush)
methods.description: Reads data from the error pipe, handling non-blocking IO, errors, and EOF conditions.

methods.name: void error_pipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when the error pipe has data to read.

methods.name: liErrorPipe * li_error_pipe_new(liServer * srv,liErrorPipeCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new error pipe with associated server and callback.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_free(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an error pipe.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_use(liErrorPipe * epipe,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Reassigns an error pipe's output to a specified destination file descriptor.

methods.name: void proc_epipe_cb(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,GString * msg)
methods.description: Callback for processing messages from the error pipe, including application name and process ID.

methods.name: liProc * li_proc_new(liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates a new server process with specified arguments, environment, user/group IDs, resource limits, and setup callback.

methods.name: void li_proc_free(liProc * proc)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a server process.

ctags.name: li_proc_new
ctags.pattern: /^liProc* li_proc_new(liServer *srv, gchar **args, gchar **env, uid_t uid, gid_t gid, gchar *usern/
ctags.signature: (liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
